correctness.rationale: The slack-variable bijection and exact rational numerator identity are algebraically reconstructed; integer polynomial remainders prove coprimality for every p>=5. Binomial expansion yields pure periods modulo all relevant prime powers. A sixth-order local expansion at q=1 forces prime-power factors in any period, cyclotomic roots force 12, and CRT completes the proof. The embedded standard-library checker independently reconstructs numerator and enumerates coefficients and examples.

value.rationale: Resolves infinitely many values of the explicit conjectural minimal-period table, including all prime powers p>=5 and composites coprime to 6. The five-adic factor is exact and exceptional; lower bounds prove minimality from n=0 rather than coarse eventual periodicity. The natural statistic is precisely the second elementary symmetric polynomial on four-part partitions.
